⚡ Universal Script PRO - Advanced Movement Controller
🚀 Ultimate Roblox Enhancement Tool
Take complete control of your Roblox experience with this premium-grade universal script featuring a sleek, modern interface and powerful movement capabilities!

✨ Key Features
🏃 Custom Speed Control

Adjust your walkspeed from 1 to 500+ in real-time
Smooth, lag-free speed modifications
Toggle ON/OFF instantly with a single click
Default optimal speed: 50 (3x normal speed)

👻 Advanced Noclip System

Phase through walls, doors, and any obstacle
Explore hidden areas and bypass barriers effortlessly
Intelligent collision detection override
Safe toggle system - re-enables collisions when turned off

🎮 Infinite Yield Integration

One-click access to the legendary Infinite Yield admin commands
Instant loading with built-in notification system
Access 300+ powerful commands at your fingertips


🎨 Premium Interface Design
Modern & Intuitive UI

Sleek gradient design with smooth animations
Fully draggable window - position anywhere on screen
Minimize to dock button - clean workspace when not in use
Bottom-right notifications - stay informed without clutter
Responsive controls - instant feedback on every action

Smart Features

Persistent across respawns - no need to re-execute
Auto-clamp positioning - never lose your window off-screen
Smooth tweening animations - professional feel
Loading screen - polished startup experience


🔧 How to Use

Execute the script in your executor
Adjust speed in the input box (default: 50)
Toggle Speed ON to activate custom walkspeed
Toggle Noclip ON to walk through walls
Click Infinite Yield for advanced admin commands
Minimize to dock button when not needed
Drag anywhere for perfect positioning
